_readme: The one place for what the owner fills in: the company's details (both sites' legal pages and footers), the store links, the web checkout and the prices. Empty strings stay visible as TODO marks (company) or fall back (stores: « soon »; checkout: the store badges and « web subscription coming soon »).

beta._readme: The public beta (the site's « Join the beta » page, /beta/). testflight: the TestFlight public link (https://testflight.apple.com/join/…); play: the Google Play testing link (https://play.google.com/apps/testing/…). Empty: the badge reads « coming soon » and the page says the beta opens in a few days. cap: the places, as the page shows them after « Places: » (e.g. « 500 », « 120 left »), one text for every language or {"en": …, "fr": …, "de": …, "es": …}; empty: no line.

checkout._readme: url: one template for every plan and period, {plan} = solo|duo|famille, {period} = month|year, {lang} = en|fr|de|es; the page adds &currency=EUR|USD|… (the visitor's choice; or put {currency} in the template). links: optional per plan/period overrides, e.g. {"duo": {"year": "https://…"}}. Both empty = no web checkout yet. The guichet answers « bientôt sur le site » until its [web] enabled is on, and « complet » when the offer is full.
checkout._urlWhenLive: https://guichet.bipagents.com/v1/web/checkout?plan={plan}&period={period}&lang={lang} (put it back in url once guichet.bipagents.com answers and its [web] is on)

prices._readme: Each currency its own round prices (decided 2026-10-23, not Stripe's conversion): the same table as the guichet's guichet.toml ([web.currencies] and the plans' web.<currency>), keep them equal. web = sold on the site (Stripe), store = App Store / Google Play in that currency (null: not known yet, the « in the app » and savings lines are hidden). year = 10 months for 12. tax: inclusive (VAT/GST inside the price) or exclusive (sales tax added at checkout, « + taxes » shown). countries: the visitor's region (browser language) that picks this currency first; the one without countries is the default. symbol: the selector's label. proposal: a price not decided yet (SGD, ILS).
